subject: Action plan: legal sequencing + MAP convergence (Clearwater pilot)
messages:
From: Asha Rao <asha@clearwaterbio.com>
To: tessa.morgan@redwood.com
Cc: Ben Park <ben.park@clearwaterbio.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot MAP + legal sequencing questions

Hi Tessa —

Thanks again for the demo last week. Procurement and legal want a clear mutual action plan (MAP) and an ordered list of legal artifacts so we can align internal stakeholders. Our internal target is to get purchase authorization and signature by June 20, subject to a clean DPA/ML. A few specific asks from my side: 

- Can you provide a MAP with task-level owners (technical, security, procurement, legal) and proposed checkpoints?
- What do you see as blockers on the DPA vs MSA vs order form sequencing? Any must-have evidence (SOC 2, data residency commitments) we should share with procurement upfront?
- Will Redwood accept DocuSign + standard redlines, or do you require a different execution flow for the pilot?

Attaching our internal procurement window for context (attachment: procurement-window-CLW.xlsx).

Looking forward — Asha

Attachments: procurement-window-CLW.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Asha Rao <asha@clearwaterbio.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 1 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + legal sequencing questions

Hi Asha —

Thanks — I sketched a short MAP and attached it (Clearwater_MAP_v1.xlsx). High level sequencing I recommend for a clean go-to-close: 

1) Technical eval & pilot acceptance sign-off (engineering + product) — target June 9. Owner: Clearwater eng / Redwood CSM (Laura).
2) Security evidence & controls package (SOC 2 summary, data flow diagram) — target June 10. Owner: Redwood security (Karthik to surface SOC 2 brief).
3) DPA review & redlines (privacy) — target initial redlines by June 12, final by June 16. Owner: Clearwater legal + Redwood legal.
4) MSA negotiation (commercial/legal) — parallel to DPA but MSA finalization after DPA agreement; target June 18. Owner: procurement/legal.
5) Order form & signature (pricing + billing) — target June 20. Execution via DocuSign unless procurement requires otherwise. Owner: procurement.

Notes and risks: 
- Data residency: if Clearwater requires EU-only residency for the pilot, that will push the timeline. Flag early.
- DPA redlines around subprocessing and audit rights are the usual friction points. Karthik, I recommend we prepare a short clause-by-clause rationale to expedite.
- I'll push a short checklist to procurement for DocuSign requirements; Marcus can confirm pricing attachments.

Proposed next steps: quick 30-min alignment call tomorrow (Mon, Jun 2) at 11:00 PDT to walk through the MAP and confirm owners. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Best —
Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
Attachments: Clearwater_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 14:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: DPA redlines (initial) — Clearwater

Forwarding initial redline draft we pulled together after reviewing Clearwater's sample DPA. Major points to watch: 

- Clause 5.2 (international transfers): Clearwater has a strict ask on EU data residency for pilot data; we can offer contractual commitments but may need a technical architecture note.
- Clause 7.1 (right to audit): we can offer SOC 2 report and an annual audit window; heavy custom audit language will require legal escalation.
- Subprocessors list: we should provide an initial list and a 30-day notice process for additions.

Attachments: DPA_redlines_v1.pdf (pdf)

Tessa — if we want to keep the June 16 DPA finish target, Redwood legal will prioritize 1) drafting an explanation doc per redline; 2) proposing an alternate EU transfer clause that maps to our existing infra. Marcus please confirm pricing sheet attachment for the order form so we can signal final pricing when the MSA hits the committee.

Thanks —
Karthik
Legal, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Park <ben.park@clearwaterbio.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Asha Rao <asha@clearwaterbio.com>, procurement@clearwaterbio.com
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + legal sequencing questions

Thanks for the plan and the redlines. A couple of clarifications from procurement/legal: 

- Procurement can accommodate DocuSign; preferred flow is DocuSign envelope with MSA + DPA + order form attached. Any changes to the signing flow must be flagged now.
- For the EU residency ask: Clearwater can accept contractual commitments if Redwood confirms processor/subprocessor list and an acceptable transfer mechanism (SCCs or equivalent).
- Our procurement team will need a final pricing sheet and the order form template before the MSA goes to committee. Can Marcus share the latest pricing matrix?

We are available for the 11:00 PDT call tomorrow (Tue, Jun 3). Procurement will join as well.

Ben Park
Head of Procurement | Clearwater Biotech
procurement@clearwaterbio.com
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>

Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Pilot MAP + legal sequencing questions — updated plan & checkpoints

Thanks everyone — and great to confirm the 11:00 call. Quick summary of what Redwood will bring to tomorrow’s call and the updated checkpoints: 

- Redwood deliverables before the call: updated MAP (drive link), initial DPA redline summary (attached), and pricing matrix (MSA_pricing_sheet.xlsx).
- Customer deliverables: procurement window confirmation, preferred signatory name and DocuSign account email.
- Checkpoint calendar: 
  * Tue Jun 3 — 11:00 PDT: alignment call (30m) — confirm owners and DocuSign flow.
  * Fri Jun 6 — technical acceptance artifacts due (engineering checklist).
  * Tue Jun 10 — security evidence package shared (SOC 2 summary + DFD).
  * Thu Jun 12 — DPA initial redline reconciliation meeting (if required).
  * Tue Jun 16 — target final DPA sign-off.
  * Thu Jun 18 — MSA committee review (target final commercial terms).
  * Fri Jun 20 — order form and signature (target).

If the EU residency ask becomes a hard requirement, call that out in the call and we’ll propose SCCs + an implementation note; that may add 3–5 business days.

I’ve uploaded the MAP and artifacts here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c_CLEARWATER_MAP. DocuSign envelope link (draft) will be prepared after the MSA/DC comms finalize: https://www.docusign.com/CLW-2025-0943-envelope.

See you on the call — Tessa

Tessa Morgan
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
